text: Occam's Razor, now with 6 blades and soothing aloe strip
You have no obligation to be useful or interesting to the world.
The key is to do half-assed things in a full-assed way rather than full-assed things in a half-assed way.
Sufficiently enlightened self-interest is indistinguishable from altruism. Suff. clueless altruism is indistinguishable from self-interest.
